notes: 6 hour fishing excursion great for both novice and experienced fishermen, these 6 hour deep-sea fishing trips can fish over 40 miles of coastal waters for over 2 dozen different species of gamefish; sculpin, barracuda, rockfish, calico bass, whitefish, sheepshead, bonita and many more provide lots of angling opportunities. fish in comfort on ships with sundecks, large indoor kitchens with booth seating, and lots of other great fishing amenities. our ships have state of the art fish finding systems and huge live bait well systems that assist to catching more fish. crew members are onboard to help throughout every trip; from help with rigging your lines to tips for catching more fish and anything else you might need during your trip. outside alcohol, ice chests, coolers, or glass containers are strictly prohibited. vessel subject to change. you do not need to be an experienced fisherman to successfully catch fish. with experienced crew always nearby, any questions or help with rigging is immediately taken care of. trips catching hundreds of fish are quite common and trophy sized fish from several species are available year round. some species of fish that we encounter include halibut, yellowtail, sand bass and calico bass, barracuda, bonito, tuna, rockfish, giant sheephead, and dozens of other species. fish cleaning services are available onboard for a small fee and catch and release is also an option for those not wanting to take fish. from novice to the experienced angler, pierpoint landing is the fishing destination for you. outside alcohol, ice chests, coolers, or glass containers are strictly prohibited. vessel subject to change. ca department of fish & wildlife fishing licenses available for purchase at pierpoint landing. licenses are required for anyone 16 years of age and older. fish cleaning, gratuity, and galley, and any other on boat purchases are all cash only and are not included in ticket price. full galley is available rental rod $17.64 1-day license $21.09 annual license $71.84 (everyone 16 or older is required by law to have license) $3 parking available in office, spots 1-29 only after 1-29 is full we have additional parking in our overflow lot our kids fish free summer promotion is live!!!! one child 12&under rides free with each full fare adult ticket purchased online only. (562)983-9300 ext 0
